beats.event: Neglected under drunken Mr. Jones's rule at Manor Farm
Old Major stirs the animals with a vision of revolution
Snowball and Napoleon drive Jones out; the farm is theirs
Adopt Seven Commandments of Animalism; all animals equal
Snowball teaches reading; Napoleon takes puppies aside
Animals repel Jones at the Battle of the Cowshed
Napoleon's dogs chase Snowball off the farm
Napoleon abolishes meetings; pigs alone govern
Windmill collapses in a storm; Snowball blamed as saboteur
Beasts of England banned; a hymn to Napoleon replaces it
Second purge: dogs execute animals accused of aiding Snowball
Frederick blasts the rebuilt windmill; animals win at great cost
Boxer collapses at work; sold in secret to the knacker
Two windmills now bring income the pigs pocket
Commandments shrink to 'some animals are more equal'
Pigs walk on two legs, drink, wear clothes
At Napoleon's dinner, pigs and men are indistinguishable
